svg.aria-label: The loop of one step, lane by lane in order: /spec; build it; /refute; close them; /refute over the round; /land; /plan-orchestration [<entry>]: runs the row above for every step, unattended. Boxes: Brief-check agent, for a full step; Diagnosis agent, for a part that asks for a cause; A false premise the plan cannot absorb; A rule clash with an ADR; A user-visible choice; A brief check finding the brief cannot absorb; A cause not found; A model other than the configured one; A step that does not converge; Builder agent, unless the executor is inline or academic-paper; Reviewer agent; A model other than the configured one; Builder agent: a repair round of a full step; Diagnosis agent, for a finding whose cause is not known; Reviewer agent, when refute_after_repair is yes; A model other than the configured one; A red line for the user; A rule clash; A lock held; A worktree that cannot be removed; A shape nobody named; A wrong premise; A red check; A rule clash; A finding that is the user's; The roadmap diff; A model other than the configured one.
